title: 37ft Private Yacht Experience in Miami for 12 people
includes: Bluetooth and speakers to play your own music onboard
Independent USCG-licensed Captains available for selection.
Safety Items: Life Jackets for adults, kids and infants
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Alcoholic Beverage restrictions (18+ and older only) Allergen Alert restrictions applies
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Experience Miami from the water aboard your own private yacht. This exclusive charter gives you front‑row access to the city’s iconic skyline, celebrity homes, and crystal‑blue waters — all from the comfort of a premium vessel operated by a professional captain and crew.
Whether you’re celebrating a birthday, planning a romantic escape, or simply enjoying a day with friends and family, this private yacht experience delivers the perfect blend of relaxation, adventure, and Miami glamour.
